name: Can pool resurfacing be done in winter or during cooler months in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Is there a best season for resurfacing a pool in Southern California, and does weather affect curing?
mainEntity.text: Is there a best season for resurfacing a pool in Southern California, and does weather affect curing?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Southern California, resurfacing is possible much of the year because the climate is generally workable, but timing still matters. Dry weather helps with draining, demolition, application, and early curing, while rain or unexpected cold can slow the schedule. Extremely hot days can also be a problem because they can dry the surface too fast if the crew does not adjust the process. The practical best time is usually when the contractor can complete the work without weather interruptions and when the homeowner is ready to manage startup immediately after refill. Winter can be fine if conditions stay dry, and summer can also work if the crew is prepared for heat. The more important issue is not the season alone but whether the project can proceed without delays between draining, finishing, and refilling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool resurfacing can be done in cooler months, but weather still matters because temperature, rain, and humidity affect curing and scheduling. In Los Angeles, mild seasons often help crews work comfortably, but the project still needs dry conditions and careful startup. The best time is usually when the contractor can keep the process uninterrupted.
